building.title: Workflow state for agents
building.summary: Working on the product and systems that turn ambiguous requests into changes people can understand, review, and trust.

thinking.question: How much of an agent's intermediate state should a person have to see?

perspectives.label: Make it explicit
perspectives.view: Visible proposals, ownership, and state make consequential work easier to inspect and recover.

perspectives.label: Let the system carry it
perspectives.view: Better defaults, reversibility, and a clear activity record may create more trust than constant confirmation.

thinking.evidence: I would update this view after seeing which controls people actually use when an agent has reliable rollback and a legible history.

changedMyMind.previous: Chat was mostly a temporary interface for demonstrating models.
changedMyMind.current: Chat can remain useful while intent is forming, provided durable workflow state exists outside the conversation.
